acceptanceCriteria: AC1: testCommitSupportsStagedRenameAcrossOldAndNewPaths commits a `git mv` pair end to end — one new commit whose tree drops the old path and carries the new one (rev-parse HEAD^ == pre-rename HEAD, ls-tree --name-only HEAD == 'renamed.txt', show HEAD:renamed.txt == 'initial'; never assert on show --name-status, which may render R100).

AC2: testCommitRejectsMissingPathAbsentFromIndexAndHead keeps refusing a path tracked in neither working tree, index nor HEAD with the unchanged 'riela/git-commit missing path is not an exact tracked deletion' policy error (.policyBlocked), HEAD and index unchanged, no finalization journals.

AC3: Non-regression — existing testCommitSupportsExactTrackedDeletion (plain tracked deletion) stays green, and testCommitRejectsMissingPathOnUnbornHeadWithoutCrashing refuses on an unborn HEAD without crashing (rev-list --all --count == 0, no journals).

AC4: `arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc 'swift test --filter GitWorkflowAddonContractTests'` is green, and the full `arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc 'swift build && swift test'` reports no failure beyond the ten accepted environmental ones (6 AppKit view-hierarchy: RielaAppUXOnboardingControllerTests, RielaAppSettingsEditorNavigationTests, RielaAppWindowContentInsetTests; 3 unix-socket-unlink: WorkflowRound7AdversarialTests; WorkflowCommandTests.testPackageAppEnvironmentEnablementRunAndMonitoringScenario).
AC5: SwiftLint clean on the three changed sources.
AC6: All work committed on fix/git-commit-rename-guard and pushed to that branch only; main untouched; no force push, reset or branch deletion.

acceptanceGate: arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc 'swift build && swift test' > tmp/git-commit-rename-guard-20260921/git-commit-rename-guard-plan-1/attempt-1/full-test.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" | tee -a tmp/git-commit-rename-guard-20260921/git-commit-rename-guard-plan-1/attempt-1/full-test.log
rules: Every Swift command must run through an arm64 login shell; the default shell is Rosetta and the xctest bundle refuses to dlopen there.
Never tail the full-suite output: keep the complete log and record its final exit status. An incomplete log is not a passing check.
Run all verification in the foreground; no background, detached or daemonized commands.
Diff the observed failure set against baselineFailures and list every difference explicitly; any other failure is in scope to fix.
Confirm `git status` clean and that only fix/git-commit-rename-guard was pushed.

notes: T1 guard fix is confined to the .missing branch of validateCommitPaths (GitRepository.swift:301-312 at ca1ce34): after `ls-files --error-unmatch` exits nonzero, probe `runRepositoryGitResult(["cat-file", "-e", "HEAD:\(path)"], repository:)` and accept on exit 0; otherwise throw the unchanged policy error.

T2 is a test-only fixture change: GitTestRepository.init gains `commitInitialFile: Bool = true`; when false it still inits and `git add`s tracked.txt (the index file must exist for loadGitRepository's preflight) but skips the initial commit. Never combine commitInitialFile: false with withBareRemote.
No back-compat shim: change the check in place, no alias flag, no opt-out configuration, no message change.

Do not weaken any other validation, widen allowlist semantics, or touch the finalization journal. A HEAD-tracked directory path passes the probe but is refused downstream by requireExactStagedPaths — do not 'fix' that by weakening requireExactStagedPaths.
Documented fallback if `cat-file -e HEAD:<path>` hits an unforeseen literal-path edge: non-empty `ls-tree -z HEAD -- <path>` check.
Work only inside /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/riela-worktrees/git-commit-rename-guard; never modify the main checkout or another worktree.

reconciliation.serialPhase: Not required: a single plan with exclusive ownership of three files, no shared indexes, lockfiles or broad formatting.
